title: EPIC: Efficient Predicate-Guided Inference-Time Control for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.11722v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent text-to-image (T2I) generators can synthesize realistic images, but still struggle with compositional prompts involving multiple objects, counts, attributes, and relations. We introduce EPIC (Efficient Predicate-Guided Inference-Time Control), a training-free inference-time refinement framework for compositional T2I generation. EPIC casts refinement as predicate-guided search: it parses the original prompt once into a visual program of object variables and typed predicates, then verifies each candidate image against this program using visual evidence extracted from that image. A candidate is judged to satisfy the prompt when all predicates pass; otherwise, unmet predicates guide the next step, routing localized failures to targeted editing and layout-level or persistent failures to resampling. translated_title: EPIC：面向组合式文生图生成的高效谓词引导推理时控制
translated_abstract: 近期的文生图（T2I）生成器能够合成逼真的图像，但在处理涉及多个对象、数量、属性和关系的组合式提示时仍然存在困难。我们提出了EPIC（高效谓词引导的推理时控制），这是一个无需训练的推理时精炼框架，用于组合式文生图生成。EPIC将精炼过程转化为谓词引导的搜索：它将原始提示一次性解析为由对象变量和类型化谓词组成的视觉程序，然后利用从候选图像中提取的视觉证据对每个候选图像进行验证。当所有谓词均通过时，该候选图像被判定为满足提示；否则，未满足的谓词将引导下一步操作，将局部性失败路由至针对性的编辑操作，而将布局层面的或持续存在的失败路由至重新采样。在GenEval2基准上，EPIC将提示级Soft-TIFA GM分数从单次生成的34.16%提升至71.46%。
tldr: EPIC是一个无需训练的推理时精炼框架，通过将提示解析为谓词视觉程序并基于视觉证据验证与定向修正生成图像，大幅提升了文生图模型处理多对象、数量、属性和关系等组合式提示的能力。
en_tdlr: EPIC is a training-free, inference-time refinement framework that parses prompts into a visual program of predicates and verifies or targetedly corrects candidate images based on visual evidence, dramatically improving text-to-image models' ability to handle compositional prompts with multiple objects, counts, attributes, and relations.
